entries.title: New Delhi India ~Khan Market.jpg
entries.description: The Khan Market, New Delhi, is a major high-end shopping district. It was established in 1951 to help the refugees of the Partition of India from the North West Frontier Province (NWFP). It honors Khan Abdul Jabbar Khan who had been the Chief Minister of NWFP during the Partition
